### Reproduce the demo

* [Download the MNI152 viewer here](../../data/viewers/RAVE_dragdrop_sample.zip){target="_blank"}
* Unzip the file, open file `RAVE_MNI_template.html`, a MNI152 template viewer
* Drop the `surfaces` folder (or any surface of your choice) as demonstrated in the animation above
* The surface will show up in the viewer.
  * You may change the color by expanding control panel \> `Custom Geometry Settings` \> `Configure ROI Surfaces` \> "your_surface_filename" \> `Color`
* To clear the object, open `Configure ROI Surfaces` \> `Clear Uploaded Surfaces`
